title: Supreme Court slams Parsvnath, State officials over non-payment of compensation to homebuyers; freezes bank accounts
description: The Supreme Court on Monday came down heavily on the failure to enforce orders passed by the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (HRERA) against Parsvnath Developers to either hand over possession of flats to homebuyers or pay compensation.
